description_zh: 调用CreatePolicy接口创建一个自定义权限策略
kebab_example: aliyun ram create-policy --policy-name View-ECS-instances-in-a-specific-region --description View_ECS_instances_in_a_specified_region --policy-document '{"Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":"ecs:Describe*","Resource":"acs:ecs:cn-qingdao:*:instance/*"}],"Version":"1"}' --tag Value=alice Key=owner --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePolicy

parameters.help_en:
The name of the policy.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略名称。

长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字和短划线（-）
parameters.name: policy_name

parameters.example: View ECS instances in a specified region
parameters.help_en:
The description of the policy.

The description must be 1 to 1,024 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略描述。

长度为1~1024个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The document of the policy.

The document must be 1 to 6,144 characters in length.

For more information about policy elements and sample policies, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210969.html
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略内容。

长度为1~6144个字符。

关于权限策略元素和示例，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/93738.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/210969.html
parameters.name: policy_document
